messages:
taylor: Heads up — precision distribution chart is dropping the 0.9-1.0 bucket in the drilldown for the new q4 quant runs. Anyone seen this? @ira @maria
ira: I noticed an empty row in the drilldown table for that bucket earlier. Summary counts sum to total but the drilldown is missing the row. Seems like an aggregation key mismatch.
taylor: Repro snippet from the export pipeline: ```sql
SELECT floor(score*10)/10 AS bucket, count(*)
FROM eval_results
WHERE model = 'llama-q4'
GROUP BY bucket;
```
Problem: floor can produce -0.0 on some platforms, then later serialization to JSON yields "-0.0" vs "0.0" as keys. That will split the group.
ira: We're also doing a `to_jsonb` path that stringifies keys in telemetry: `jsonb_object_agg(bucket, cnt)` — if bucket arrives as "-0" vs "0" they'll be distinct. Repro locally with `psql` shows two keys.
eval-bot: CI run 1863509876-llama-q4-quant reported mismatch: summary count for bucket 0.9-1.0 = 123, drilldown rows for that bucket = 0. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/1863509876 (logs + export)
sam: :thinking_face: UI can coerce numeric-looking bucket keys as Number before grouping to avoid this showing up to users. Quick patch could be `Number(bucket)` in the viz layer.
maria: Prefer fixing upstream in the export serialization so all consumers get stable keys. UI fallback is fine as an emergency mitigation.
ira: Agreed. I'll normalize buckets in the runner/telemetry export: ensure we format with one decimal and canonicalize -0 to 0. Adding unit test.
taylor: Can you also add a small regression test in the scorecard exporter that compares summary vs drilldown counts per bucket? Would catch this automatically.
ira: Yep. Adding tests and a small patch now. PR coming. Example normalization I'll use: `bucket = format('%.1f', round(score*10)/10)` then if bucket == '-0.0' -> '0.0'.
ira: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/1123 — includes test `test_bucket_key_normalization`.
sam: I'll land a UI fallback change too: in chart code `const key = Number(bucket).toFixed(1)` before group. Will add unit test for chart grouping. ETA tonight.
eval-bot: Re-run of the failing eval (post-PR) completed: counts now match; drilldown shows 123 rows for 0.9-1.0. Staging UI patch deployed: https://staging.console.redwood.ai/runs/1863509876
maria: :thumbsup: Nice. Please add a short note to release notes and a monitoring alert for bucket key drift (summary vs drilldown mismatch) so we catch regressions automatically.
taylor: Thanks all. Assigning follow-up tasks: @ira - merge runner fix and backfill failing runs; @sam - UI fallback patch to main. I'll kick off backfill once PRs merged: `./ci/run_eval.sh --recompute 1863509876`
ira: Done. Merged and kicked off backfill job. Logs show normalized keys.
sam: UI patch merged and deployed to prod as a hotfix.
maria: Closing loop — added release note and created a monitoring check in dashboard (alert when any bucket has >5% discrepancy between summary and drilldown).
taylor: Great job everyone :tada:
